title: Step 2 - Handling Categorical Data: One-Hot Encoding with ColumnTransformer

cues.en: -: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: You cannot actually really guess how we are gonna do this.
cues.zh: 你可能無法直接猜出要怎麼做。

cues.en: So let's implement the solution together.
cues.zh: 我們一起實作。

cues.en: The first step is to create an object of the column transformer class and therefore we're gonna create a new variable here which I'm gonna call CT, which stands for,
cues.zh: 第一步，是建立 ColumnTransformer 類別的物件，因此新增一個變數，命名為 ct，

cues.en: you know the object of the column transformer class.
cues.zh: 代表 ColumnTransformer 的物件。

cues.en: So CT equals, and now of course remember to create an instance or an object of a class you have to call the class itself.
cues.zh: 寫 ct =，別忘了，要建立類別的實例或物件，必須呼叫類別本身。

cues.en: So column transformer class, there we go.
cues.zh: 所以寫 ColumnTransformer。

cues.en: Now since it is a class we have to add some parenthesis and site which we have to enter two arguments.
cues.zh: 再加上括號，因為它是類別，裡面要傳入兩個引數。

cues.en: So these two arguments are first transformers, where we will specify, what kind of transformation we want to do and on which indexes of the columns we want to transform.
cues.zh: 第一個叫 transformers，用來指定要做哪種轉換，以及要轉換哪些欄位索引。

cues.en: And the second argument is remainder which will specify that we actually want to keep the columns that won't be applied some transformations meaning age and salary.
cues.zh: 第二個叫 remainder，用來指定保留不做轉換的欄位，也就是 Age 與 Salary。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 我們開始。

cues.en: Let's first enter the names of these two arguments.
cues.zh: 先把這兩個引數的名稱寫出來。

cues.en: The first one is transformers.
cues.zh: 第一個是 transformers。

cues.en: There we go, this one, transformers.
cues.zh: 就是這個 transformers。

cues.en: I'm gonna add a column here and then let's just add the next one and then we'll input them.
cues.zh: 這裡先加逗號，再寫下一個引數，之後才填值。

cues.en: The next one is, remainder, this one, exactly.
cues.zh: 下一個正是 remainder。

cues.en: And now let's input them.
cues.zh: 現在開始填入內容。

cues.en: So for the first one, transformers we actually have to specify three things.
cues.zh: transformers 需要指定三件事。

cues.en: First, the kind of transformation which is encoding.
cues.zh: 第一，轉換的類型，也就是編碼。

cues.en: Second, what kind of encoding we want to do which is, one hot encoding.
cues.zh: 第二，使用哪種編碼，也就是獨熱編碼。

cues.en: And third, the indexes of the columns we want to encode meaning country, the country column.
cues.zh: 第三，要編碼哪些欄位的索引，也就是 Country 欄位。

cues.en: So we have to actually input all that, in a pair of square brackets and then some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 這些內容要放在一組方括號中，再加上圓括號。

cues.en: So that's just the format expected by this transformer argument.
cues.zh: 這就是 transformers 引數要求的格式。

cues.en: We're actually going to enter here, tuple, you know three elements inside these parenthesis.
cues.zh: 圓括號裡其實是一個 tuple，包含三個元素。

cues.en: The first element is, as we said, the kind of transformation.
cues.zh: 第一個元素如前所述，是轉換的名稱。

cues.en: And to specify that we want to do some encoding transformation, we have to enter here in quotes encoder.
cues.zh: 要表示這是編碼轉換，這裡輸入引號中的 encoder。

cues.en: So that's the first element.
cues.zh: 這是第一個元素。

cues.en: Then second element, we simply have to enter the exact name of the class that will proceed to this encoding.
cues.zh: 第二個元素，直接填入要執行這種編碼的類別名稱。

cues.en: So I'm going to copy this, because this is going to be, exactly the second element expected here and I'm adding some parenthesis because that's a class.
cues.zh: 我先複製過來，這正是需要的第二個元素，並加上括號，因為要建立類別物件。

cues.en: And finally, the third element inside this tuple of parenthesis is in a pair of new square brackets the indexes of the columns we want to apply
cues.zh: 最後，tuple 中的第三個元素，是放在另一組方括號裡的欄位索引，指定要在哪些欄位

cues.en: one hot encoding, you know, we want to transform.
cues.zh: 進行獨熱編碼，也就是轉換。

cues.en: And so these indexes, of course are only one index.
cues.zh: 這裡其實只有一個索引。

cues.en: It is the index of the country column.
cues.zh: 就是 Country 欄位的索引。

cues.en: The country column is the first column of our matrix of features.
cues.zh: Country 是特徵矩陣中的第一欄。

cues.en: And remember that in python indexes start at zero therefore this country column has index zero and that's what we have to enter here, only zero.
cues.zh: Python 索引從 0 起算，所以 Country 的索引是 0，這裡只需填入 0。

cues.en: All right, so that's all good for the first argument here.
cues.zh: 第一個引數就完成了。

cues.en: You know transformers, the transformers argument is equal to all this, you know, in square brackets, so great.
cues.zh: transformers 就等於這整組放在方括號中的內容，很好。

cues.en: And now the second argument remainder.
cues.zh: 接下來是第二個引數 remainder。

cues.en: So here we want to specify in quote the following code name, which is passthrough, and which is a code name that will say that we indeed want to keep
cues.zh: 這裡要輸入引號中的 passthrough，它表示我們要保留

cues.en: the columns that won't be applied some transformation that won't be one hot encoded Which are of course age and salary.
cues.zh: 沒有套用轉換、沒有做獨熱編碼的欄位，也就是 Age 與 Salary。

cues.en: If we don't include this remainder equals passthrough here.
cues.zh: 如果不加上 remainder='passthrough'，

cues.en: Then when we apply the transformation on X we will only keep, you know the first three columns resulting from one hot encoding.
cues.zh: 對 X 進行轉換後，就只會留下獨熱編碼產生的前三個欄位。

cues.en: And of course we want to keep age and salary into our matrix of features.
cues.zh: 但特徵矩陣中，當然也要保留年齡與薪資。

cues.en: That's what it's used for, okay, so good.
cues.zh: 這就是這個設定的用途。

cues.en: Now we have our CT object.
cues.zh: 現在，ct 物件已建立完成。

cues.en: It is of course not connected yet to our matrix features X.
cues.zh: 但還沒有連結到特徵矩陣 X。

cues.en: And so that's exactly what we want to do.
cues.zh: 這正是接下來要做的事。

cues.en: But there is actually some good news this time we don't have to do it in two steps, you know by first calling a fit method from the object to connect our object to the matrix of features X, and then apply as a second step
cues.zh: 好消息是，這次不需要分成兩步：先呼叫 fit 把物件與 X 連結，再

cues.en: the transform method to apply the transformation.
cues.zh: 呼叫 transform 執行轉換。

cues.en: No, this time we can do it at once because our column transformer class actually has a method called fit transform which will do exactly the process of fitting
cues.zh: 這次可以一次完成，因為 ColumnTransformer 提供 fit_transform 方法，同時進行擬合

cues.en: and transforming at once at the same time, you know, so that's perfect, let's use this.
cues.zh: 與轉換，非常方便，我們就用它。

cues.en: And to use this, well of course we have to call first our CT object from which we're gonna call this, fit transform method, which will get as input
cues.zh: 先取出 ct 物件，再呼叫 fit_transform，並傳入

cues.en: well of course X because that's what we want to transform.
cues.zh: 當然就是 X，因為 X 正是要轉換的資料。

cues.en: We want to transform the matrix of features X inside which we want to one hot encode the country column.
cues.zh: 我們要轉換特徵矩陣 X，對其中的 Country 欄位做獨熱編碼。

cues.en: Perfect, so now two things to understand.
cues.zh: 很好，現在有兩件事要了解。

cues.en: Well first, this fit transform method, will of course return as output the new matrix of features X with the three columns, one hot encoding the country column.
cues.zh: 首先，fit_transform 會輸出新的特徵矩陣，其中 Country 已轉成三個獨熱編碼欄位。

cues.en: And therefore, since that's exactly what we want to get as the new matrix of features X, well we're just going to update this new matrix of features X.
cues.zh: 既然這就是新的 X，我們就直接更新 X。

cues.en: So that's why I'm adding here X equals the result, you know the output of this fit transfer method.
cues.zh: 所以這裡寫 X 等於 fit_transform 的輸出結果。

cues.en: But then we have to do one more thing, which is related to the fact that, the fit transfer method actually doesn't return the output as a NumPy array.
cues.zh: 但還要再做一件事，因為 fit_transform 的輸出不一定是 NumPy 陣列。

cues.en: And it is absolutely compulsory to have X as NumPy array, because this will be expected by the future machinery models which we're gonna build.
cues.zh: 而 X 必須是 NumPy 陣列，才能符合接下來要建立的機器學習模型所要求的格式。

cues.en: You know, in order to train the future machinery models where we're gonna use a train function, which is actually called fit.
cues.zh: 之後訓練模型時，會使用名為 fit 的訓練方法。

cues.en: And this train function will expect the matrix of features X as a NumPy array.
cues.zh: 這個方法需要 NumPy 陣列形式的特徵矩陣 X。

cues.en: So here we want to force the output of this fit transfer method to be a NumPy array.
cues.zh: 所以這裡要強制把 fit_transform 的輸出轉成 NumPy 陣列。

cues.en: And to do this, we simply need to call well NumPy first which has a shortcut name NP from which we're gonna call this array function which will take as input exactly the output
cues.zh: 做法很簡單，先呼叫簡稱為 np 的 NumPy，再使用 array 函式，把

cues.en: of the fit transform method.
cues.zh: fit_transform 的輸出傳進去。
